notes: Issuer tender offer by a non-listed REIT (described as 'a real estate investment trust incorporated in Maryland', transitioning from a BDC to a property-focused REIT); kind cef_tender per the guide (issuer tender for its own shares), fund_type reit. Fixed price $6.00 per Share; the Board RECOMMENDS AGAINST tendering. The filing states an Estimated Per-Share NAV of $9.84 as of December 31, 2020 and that 'The purchase price is 39% lower than Estimated Per-Share NAV'; a percent-of-NAV price would need arithmetic, so price_pct_nav is null and nav_pricing_date is null (price not NAV-based). size_pct_outstanding is null: 400,000 Shares against 13,362,419.23 outstanding (March 19, 2021) needs arithmetic. Expiration is 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time, April 19, 2021. Proration does not apply to 'All or None' tenders. Offer not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares. trigger_origin board_discretionary: the regular share repurchase programme was suspended in May 2020 and the filing says there are no current plans to reinstate it, so this is a one-off board-approved liquidity offer rather than a periodic one. 'other' condition = purchase would violate securities, commodities or other laws. No ticker (CUSIP 'N/A'; shares not traded on an established market).
